issues.observation: Prior grid occupied only 76 by 76 units within the board, leaving excessive interior margins.

observations: Expanded grid remains visible on both backgrounds at 16/24/32 px.
Black and white stones remain distinct; their scale is coherent with the grid.
Warm wood, rounded board edges, upper-left highlights and shaded thickness retain the accepted style.
limitations: Creator critique rather than an independent recognition test.
